segments.text: When does native ETH show up as a Transfer log — and when does it stay invisible?
EIP-7708 makes ETH moves emit an ERC-20 style Transfer event. Amsterdam ships it inside Glamsterdam.
Plain transfer, one wei — the receipt now carries one Transfer log from the system address.
Osaka: no EIP-7708 rules, no Transfer log. Indexers stay blind to native ETH.
The rule stays honest — zero-value moves and reverted calls emit nothing.
Amsterdam only. Non-zero, non-reverted ETH moves — one Transfer log per hop.
Read the EIP on Forkcast. Feel it live on feelyourprotocol dot org.
